dataset.name: Pediatric low-grade glioma cohort (CPTAC, 2020)
dataset.description: Independent pediatric low-grade glioma cohort restricted to primary, treatment-naive tumors with bulk RNA sequencing and source-defined disease/progression-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The CPTAC pediatric brain-tumor study contains several distinct histologies. TRACE Explorer retains only samples labelled pediatric low-grade glioma, Primary and Treatment naive; other pediatric brain tumors are not pooled into PLGG.

metadata.histology_note: Ependymoma, pediatric high-grade glioma, ganglioglioma, medulloblastoma, craniopharyngioma and atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor records are excluded.
metadata.treatment_note: Only records explicitly labelled Treatment naive in both source treatment fields are eligible.
metadata.endpoint_note: Overall survival is not exposed because only one death is observed in the endpoint-complete PLGG subset.
metadata.overlap_note: PLGG is a pediatric entity and is not mapped to the adult TCGA-LGG cohort.

expression.label: Provided log2(FPKM + 1) expression
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned CPTAC/DataHub matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All rows for the duplicated symbols BTBD8 and MYO18A are excluded rather than implicitly aggregated, leaving 18,205 uniquely identified complete symbols.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub molecular-profile metadata defines the supplied values as log2(FPKM + 1). TRACE Explorer preserves that scale without a second transformation.

endpoints.label: Disease/progression-free survival (source DFS)
endpoints.time_origin: Initial treatment, according to the source clinical dictionary
endpoints.event_definition: Recurrence or progression as encoded by the source DFS status
